reply.analysis: No exact rate was certified: the verdict is gap, with bracket [136, 152]. The independent set of size 136 and the clique cover of 152 both passed their checks, so beta lies between 136 and 152. Two codes were tried (the family rule's p=2, c=1 and one more) and none closed the bracket. Baselines: CP-SAT proved alpha = 136 in 23.1 s, agreeing with our lower bound, but it did not improve on 152 for the upper side (its cover search ended at 433, unproven, after 121 s). The Kushagra agent's upper was 732. Our run took 37.3 s wall (34.6 s LLM, 2.7 s compute), faster than the baselines but with the gap left open. Nothing suspicious.
